response.sql: WITH spatial_ratios AS (SELECT ssp.arcref, CASE WHEN ssp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ssp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ssp.boxz <> 0 THEN ssp.boxx / ssp.boxz ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM scanspatial ssp INNER JOIN projects p ON ssp.arcref = p.arcregistry), project_ratios AS (SELECT arcref, AVG(ratio) AS project_ratio FROM spatial_ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arcref), project_with_funding AS (SELECT pr.arcref, p.fundflux, pr.project_ratio FROM project_ratios pr INNER JOIN projects p ON pr.arcref = p.arcregistry), funding_source_averages AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(project_ratio) AS funding_source_avg FROM project_with_funding GROUP BY fundflux), excess_calculation AS (SELECT pwf.arcref AS project_id, pwf.fundflux AS funding_source, pwf.project_ratio AS ratio, pwf.project_ratio - fsa.funding_source_avg AS excess FROM project_with_funding pwf INNER JOIN funding_source_averages fsa ON pwf.fundflux = fsa.fundflux) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM excess_calculation ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Spatial records with boxz = 0 are treated as having invalid (NULL) ratios and excluded from averaging, as division by zero is mathematically undefined and the request does not specify how to handle this edge case
Projects without any valid spatial records (where boxx or boxz is NULL or missing) are excluded from the output, as they contribute no ratios to project-level or funding source-level averages
